pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex polygonal geometries with high-frequency edge irregularities. The dark regions exhibit sharp pixel-level transitions into the interstitial network, with a predominant distribution of jagged, non-linear boundaries across the flank and upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected web of light-pigmented pathways. The network displays variable thickness, with wider corridor nodes at the base of the neck transitioning to narrower, more constrained pathways on the mid-flank. Junctions are primarily tri-radial and quad-radial.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Distinct 1D silhouette on the dorsal neck line composed of high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical projections representing hair tufts against the background sky.
